summary: Stock Management: Edit Items panel fields don't update when selecting a different stock item
description:
When a stock item is selected from the list and the edit side panel is open, selecting a different stock item only updates the item name at the top of the panel. All other fields retain the values from the previously selected item.
  Steps to Reproduce:
Navigate to Stock Management → Items (/openmrs/spa/stock-management/items)

Select a stock item from the list to open the edit side panel

While the panel is still open, select a different stock item from the list

  Expected Behavior:  All fields in the edit side panel should update to reflect the newly selected stock item.
  Actual Behavior:  Only the item name at the top of the panel updates. All other fields (e.g., category, dispensing unit,  etc.) remain populated with the previously selected item's data.
